question.text: Under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations Chapter X-A, a Social Enterprise listed on SSE must file an Annual Impact Report in Form RODD-A within how many days of the end of each financial year?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI ICDR Reg 292L requires Form RODD-A to be filed within 90 days of FY-end. The AIR is the regulated equivalent of the voluntary Social Impact Report and is audited/certified by an SIA empanelled with the ICAI SIAB (SRO). **The Trap:** 30 and 60 days are common distractors (they match LODR financial-result timelines); 180 days is the CSR annual return window under Companies Act Section 135, not SEBI ICDR. **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A/III-C Compliance tests SEBI LODR quarterly/annual timelines. XXIII layers the SSE-specific 90-day window on top. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Plan the AIR engagement backwards from 31 May assuming a March-end FY: field work should finish by end-April, draft SIR mid-May, signed Form RODD-A by 25 June. Build a two-week contingency for SE-side evidence-gathering delays.
